title: The old cluster is a peripheral of the ICU**
outcome: **The old cluster is a peripheral of the ICU** — no `DP-CLU`; the senders terminate at `DP-ICU-B`, the ICU excites fuel and water temp, reads the PMU-excited oil node, drives the three gauges and passes the rest through a twelve-line CLU pigtail; `DP-ICU-A 6` = F16 aux, `DP-ICU-B 10–12` = tell-tale senses.
